One who mutilates women, slays a yogin or a knower [of reality], or omits
occasional rites, should recite [the mantra] double [the standard number], beginning with one hundred thousand.

28.s:
vratena kenacidyukto mitabhugbrahmacaryavān /
dūtīparigrahe'nyatra gataścetkāmamohitaḥ // 422
28.d:
व्रतेन केनचिद्युक्तो मितभुग्ब्रह्मचर्यवान् ।
दूतीपरिग्रहेऽन्यत्र गतश्चेत्काममोहितः ॥ 422
28.m:
Undertaking some vow, eating moderately, and observing celibacy,
if, deluded by desire, he goes elsewhere in the acceptance of a female partner (dūtī),

28.s:
lakṣajāpaṃ tataḥ kuryādityuktaṃ brahmayāmale /
dīkṣābhiṣekanaimittavidhyante gurupūjanam // 423
28.d:
लक्षजापं ततः कुर्यादित्युक्तं ब्रह्मयामले ।
दीक्षाभिषेकनैमित्तविध्यन्ते गुरुपूजनम् ॥ 423
28.m:
he should then perform one hundred thousand recitations—so it is stated in the Brahmayāmala.
At the conclusion of the rules for initiation, consecration, and occasional rites, worship of the guru

28.s:
aparedyuḥ sadā kāryaṃ siddhayogīśvarīmate /
pūrvoktalakṣaṇopetaḥ kavistrikasatattvavit // 424
28.d:
अपरेद्युः सदा कार्यं सिद्धयोगीश्वरीमते ।
पूर्वोक्तलक्षणोपेतः कविस्त्रिकसतत्त्ववित् ॥ 424
28.m:
must always be performed on the following day, according to the doctrine of the Siddhayogīśvarī.
Endowed with the aforementioned characteristics, an inspired sage knowing the true reality of the Trika,

28.s:
sa guruḥ sarvadā grāhyastyaktvānyaṃ tatsthitaṃ tvapi /
maṇḍale svastikaṃ kṛtvā tatra haimādikāsanam // 425
28.d:
स गुरुः सर्वदा ग्राह्यस्त्यक्त्वान्यं तत्स्थितं त्वपि ।
मण्डले स्वस्तिकं कृत्वा तत्र हैमादिकासनम् ॥ 425
28.m:
he is the guru who should always be accepted, abandoning another even if already settled in that office.
Having drawn a svastika in the mandala, having made there a seat of gold or other materials,

28.s:
kṛtvārcayeta tatrasthamadhvānaṃ sakalāntakam /
tato vijñapayedbhaktyā tadadhiṣṭhitaye gurum // 426
28.d:
कृत्वार्चयेत तत्रस्थमध्वानं सकलान्तकम् ।
ततो विज्ञपयेद्भक्त्या तदधिष्ठितये गुरुम् ॥ 426
28.m:
he should worship the path extending up to the Sakala that resides there.
Then, with devotion, he should pray to the guru to preside over it.

28.s:
sa tatra pūjyaḥ svairmantraiḥ puṣpadhūpārghavistaraiḥ /
samālambhanasadvastrairnaivedyaistarpaṇaiḥ kramāt // 427
28.d:
स तत्र पूज्यः स्वैर्मन्त्रैः पुष्पधूपार्घविस्तरैः ।
समालम्भनसद्वस्त्रैर्नैवेद्यैस्तर्पणैः क्रमात् ॥ 427
28.m:
There he is to be worshipped with his own mantras, with abundant flowers, incense, and oblations,
with unguents, fine garments, food offerings, and libations in succession.

28.s:
āśāntaṃ pūjayitvainaṃ dakṣiṇābhiryajecchiśuḥ /
sarvasvamasmai saṃdadyādātmānamapi bhāvitaḥ // 428
28.d:
आशान्तं पूजयित्वैनं दक्षिणाभिर्यजेच्छिशुः ।
सर्वस्वमस्मै संदद्यादात्मानमपि भावितः ॥ 428
28.m:
Having worshipped him to his satisfaction, the spiritual child should honor him with sacrificial fees (dakṣiṇā);
filled with devotion, he should surrender all his possessions and even himself to him.

28.s:
atoṣayitvā tu guruṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ samantataḥ /
tattvajño'pyṛṇabandhena tena yātyadhikāritām // 429
28.d:
अतोषयित्वा तु गुरुं दक्षिणाभिः समन्ततः ।
तत्त्वज्ञोऽप्यृणबन्धेन तेन यात्यधिकारिताम् ॥ 429
28.m:
For without pleasing the guru completely with sacrificial gifts,
even a knower of reality incurs disqualification through the bondage of that debt.

28.s:
gurupūjāmakurvāṇaḥ śataṃ janmāni jāyate /
adhikārī tato muktiṃ yātīti skandayāmale // 430
28.d:
गुरुपूजामकुर्वाणः शतं जन्मानि जायते ।
अधिकारी ततो मुक्तिं यातीति स्कन्दयामले ॥ 430
28.m:
Failing to perform the worship of the guru, he is born for a hundred lifetimes
as an adhikārin [bound by worldly office], and only then attains liberation—so it is said in the Skandayāmala.

28.s:
tasmādavaśyaṃ dātavyā gurave dakṣiṇā punaḥ /
pūrvaṃ hi yāgāṅgatayā proktaṃ tattuṣṭaye tvidam // 431
28.d:
तस्मादवश्यं दातव्या गुरवे दक्षिणा पुनः ।
पूर्वं हि यागाङ्गतया प्रोक्तं तत्तुष्टये त्विदम् ॥ 431
28.m:
Therefore, a sacrificial fee must by all means be given to the guru again;
for earlier it was enjoined as an ancillary of the sacrifice, but this is for his personal satisfaction.

28.s:
tajjuṣṭamatha tasyājñāṃ prāpyāśnīyātsvayaṃ śiśuḥ /
tataḥ prapūjayeccakraṃ yathāvibhavasambhavam // 432
28.d:
तज्जुष्टमथ तस्याज्ञां प्राप्याश्नीयात्स्वयं शिशुः ।
ततः प्रपूजयेच्चक्रं यथाविभवसम्भवम् ॥ 432
28.m:
Then, having received his permission, the spiritual child himself should consume his leftovers;
thereafter he should worship the circle according to the extent of his means.

28.s:
akṛtvā guruyāgaṃ tu kṛtamapyakṛtaṃ yataḥ /
tasmātprayatnataḥ kāryo guruyāgo yathābalam // 433
28.d:
अकृत्वा गुरुयागं तु कृतमप्यकृतं यतः ।
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतः कार्यो गुरुयागो यथाबलम् ॥ 433
28.m:
Since without performing the worship of the guru, even what has been done is as good as undone,
therefore the worship of the guru must be performed with effort, according to one's capacity.

28.s:
atatrastho'pi hi guruḥ pūjyaḥ saṃkalpya pūrvavat /
taddravyaṃ devatākṛtye kuryādbhaktajaneṣvatha // 434
parvapavitraprabhṛtiprabhedi naimittikaṃ tvidaṃ karma /
28.d:
अतत्रस्थोऽपि हि गुरुः पूज्यः संकल्प्य पूर्ववत् ।
तद्द्रव्यं देवताकृत्ये कुर्याद्भक्तजनेष्वथ ॥ 434
पर्वपवित्रप्रभृतिप्रभेदि नैमित्तिकं त्विदं कर्म ।
